resolution: Existing canonical PQ94 acquisition and non-Ultimate-Finish semantics retained. Existing canonical Ki Blast classification and CaC availability were not rewritten to the current Other-category presentation because this bounded pass is provenance verification, not taxonomy normalization. No drop probability or stronger gate inferred.
